result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: overlapping text in the restaurant details line makes part of the content hard to read.

issues.description: The metadata line under “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” appears visually overlapped or duplicated. The delivery time/delivery text collides with other text, making the line difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Review the layout constraints for the restaurant info row. Ensure each metadata item has enough horizontal space, uses proper spacing between separators, and truncates gracefully if the content is too long.
